settings.turnTimeHint: Record the end time of new turns; earlier turns are not backfilled, and times already recorded stay when this is off.
settings.foldTimeHint: Show the latest update time of each activity or folded summary in the viewer's local time zone.
settings.theseColorsAndExpansionSettings: These colors and expansion settings apply when takeover is turned on again.
settings.sidebarHint: Off removes this plugin's settings entry from the left sidebar; the command palette entry stays. Changes apply to all devices.
settings.followHint: On: an expanded area scrolls to the newest output as it updates; scrolling up pauses the follow. Changes apply to all devices.
settings.wrapHint: On: long lines wrap to the available width; off keeps one row with horizontal scrolling. Row titles and paths stay single-line. Changes apply to all devices.
settings.strengthDim: 30% — a faint outline; hover, focus or expand a row to read it.
settings.strengthFull: No fading. Every row stays at full strength.
settings.previewThinkingOnly: Thinking rows only: the plugin redraws thinking rows, tool rows stay with Paseo.
settings.previewTakeoverOff: Takeover is off — the plugin draws no rows, so there is nothing to preview.
settings.previewQuestion: Make the login module's timeout retries exponential and add tests.
settings.previewReasoning:
Step 1: find where the timeout comes from.
Step 2: read the retry helper.
Step 3: check the tests.
Step 4: draft the exponential backoff.
Step 5: base delay 200 ms.
Step 6: cap at 5 tries.
Step 7: add jitter.
Step 8: cover the timeout branch.
Step 9: cover the success branch.
Step 10: run the suite.
Step 11: fix the flake.
Step 12: rerun.
Step 13: update the README.
Step 14: note the new setting.
Step 15: tidy the exports.
Step 16: recheck types.
Step 17: rerun the suite.
Step 18: green.
Step 19: summarize.
Step 20: open the PR.
Step 21: await review.
Step 22: address comments.
Step 23: squash.
Step 24: final suite.
Step 25: push.
Step 26: done.
settings.tailFollowHint: On: an expanded thinking row shows the latest lines and follows the output as it streams. Off: it stays on its first 20 lines (up to 4,000 characters) until you press Expand all.
settings.tailLinesHint: Lines (block view) or steps (step view) kept in the window, 5–500. Default 20.
settings.tailLinesInvalid: Enter a whole number between 5 and 500.
settings.commandColorsHint: Syntax colors for the shell command in a row's title (colors from the theme).
settings.foldConsecutiveThinkingAndTool: Fold consecutive thinking and tool rows when finished
settings.takeoverIsOffFoldingAnd: Takeover is off. Folding, row density and strength apply when takeover is turned on again.
settings.onlyThinkingRowsAreTaken: Only thinking rows are taken over: adjacent thinking rows can fold. Paseo displays tool rows, which can be grouped using "Settings → Chat → Tool call display → Summary".
settings.theSameRowHeightAnd: The same row height and spacing as previous versions, with 10 px gaps.
settings.shorterRowsWith4Px: Shorter rows with 4 px gaps, offsetting Paseo's 16 px spacing for plugin rows. About 20% more fits on a phone and 40% more on a desktop.
settings.planCardsTaskRowsApproval: Plan cards, task rows, approval cards, and cards from plugins such as Bots. Changes apply to all devices.
settings.expandOnlyTheLatestTask: Expand only the latest task list tool row.
settings.startTaskListToolRows: Start task list tool rows collapsed.
settings.alwaysExpandTaskListTool: Always expand task list tool rows.
settings.startCollapsedEvenWhileRunning: Start collapsed, even while running. Tap to expand.
settings.expandOnlyTheLatestRow: Expand only the latest row. Collapse it when a new row arrives.
settings.expandEveryRowOldAnd: Expand every row, old and new.
settings.expandFailedRowsHint: Only failed rows start open; a running row opens once it fails. Same as collapsed for thinking rows and task lists.
settings.thickerSeparatorsAndStrongerStatus: Thicker separators and stronger status colors.
settings.iconsAreMostlyNeutralOnly: Icons are mostly neutral. Only status uses color.
settings.theOriginalColorfulAgentActivity: The original colorful-agent-activity palette: icons use the theme's accent color and row backgrounds stay neutral.
settings.eachToolCategoryHasA: Each tool category has a color (purple for thinking, blue for reading, green for editing, orange for commands, indigo for search). Running spins blue, approval pulses amber, failure is red, and completion is green.
settings.letPaseoDisplayAllRows: Let Paseo display all rows. The plugin stays installed and can be turned on at any time.
settings.redrawThinkingRowsOnlyPaseo: Redraw thinking rows only. Paseo keeps its tool rows, including "Summary" grouping and file links.
settings.replaceThinkingAndToolCall: Replace thinking and tool call rows with colorful activity rows.
settings.takeoverCosts:
· "Settings → Chat → Tool call display → Summary" no longer combines tool rows into one sentence
· File paths cannot be clicked to open files
· On phones, tool details expand within the row instead of opening a details page
settings.foldHint: When a sequence of thinking and tool calls finishes, fold it into one row showing category counts, failures, duration, and the files changed with lines added and removed (edits whose lines are known). The last fold of a turn also shows the turn's tokens, for turns you watched while they ran. Tap to expand it, listing each file and failed command, or to collapse it. A running sequence keeps running, waiting for approval, failed, and the two latest steps visible. Earlier steps fold into "Previous N steps". Changes apply to all devices.
settings.pinHint: After an agent has worked for a while and sent several messages, pin this turn's prompt above its latest activity. Show three lines by default. Tap to read or copy the full text. The prompt stays hidden while it is nearby (within about one screen). Changes apply to all devices.
settings.loaderHint: The mark at the end of a running row: a spinner (default), a Claude Code style sparkle, a breathing orb or a 3×3 dot grid. It pauses while the app is in the background and holds still when the system asks for reduced motion. Changes apply to all devices.
settings.fontFamilyHint: Web and desktop. Fonts installed on the device that shows Paseo, separated by commas, for example "JetBrains Mono", monospace. Leave empty for the default. A font the device does not have falls back to the default; the phone app keeps its system monospace font.
settings.fontFamilyInvalid: Use font names only (letters, digits, spaces and . _ + -), separated by commas, at most 200 characters.
settings.textSizeHint: Everything the rows draw in the code font: summaries, paths, commands, code, diffs, tool output and thinking text. Titles and labels keep their size.
